title: Turkish Genitive Case Suffix (-in)
explanation: Attach genitive suffix '-in/-ın/-un/-ün' to the possessor noun, and a possessive suffix to the possessed noun.

example_translations.ex_trgen_1: This house's door is very big.

common_error_explanations.err_trgen_1: Use genitive on the first noun and possessive suffix on the second noun.
